brief: A 10-second cinematic short at sunrise in exactly three shots. Shot 1: a sleek, low, unbranded red two-seat electric roadster with small thruster ports, driven by a slim white-and-black humanoid robot with a glossy black faceplate (no logos, no people), drives northbound across the Golden Gate Bridge while ahead, beyond the north tower, a hillside on the Marin Headlands collapses into a landslide dust cloud. Shot 2: thrusters flare under the car and it hops up off the bridge deck and arcs around in mid-air above the suspension cables. Shot 3: the roadster lands on the southbound lanes and drives toward the San Francisco skyline, ending with the title 'Safe Return'.
